metrics_scope.launch: unchanged small native C supervisor forks before exec, avoiding Python inherited high-water floor
metrics_scope.allocations: Go counters exclude SQLite/native allocations; provider global counters may be disabled and are not total memory
metrics_scope.idle: no background service installed or measured; commands terminate; production idle/wakeup cost not applicable
metrics_scope.storage: private final pre-FTS file bytes plus incremental FTS; not peak journal/storage or power-loss durability

installation.prototype: build-tagged manual command, not installed; package/source-release/install qualification of a hypothetical adopted backend is not claimed
installation.closure: Required prototype executable/loaded-file bytes and SDK/header/library/compiler identities are measured; SDK expanded bytes are logical regular-file bytes. Complete distribution-package payload size is not measured.
installation.licensing: Evaluation source keeps project GPL notices; approved Go SDK license is retained/hash-bound; SQLite headers carry public-domain notice. Distribution-provided base libraries retain their package licenses/update ownership. No library adoption or vulnerability assessment follows.

phase_limits.reopen: SQLite opens connection and checks schema/generation; JSON snapshot decodes and rebuilds the full model. Subsequent observation is outside that phase. These are different work placements, not an equal full-restart speedup.
phase_limits.durability: SQLite requests FULL synchronous/DELETE journal. Snapshot publishes by rename without power-loss qualification. Observed I/O costs are not equal-durability storage claims.
phase_limits.fts: Separate pre-normalized ASCII token-prefix experiment, not existing Unicode literal substring behavior; index construction and file growth are separate.
phase_limits.memory: Every process retains the same synthetic input; measure mode omits reference/oracle models and fault controls. Go allocations are not total native memory.
phase_limits.scope: Full ordered ID projections only, not pagination/render/installed consumer or hardware/whole-desktop qualification.
